cve_records WHERE attributed_to = 'summit-analytics' AND state = 'PUBLISHED' AND datePublished IN (2024-10-06T12:00:00.000Z, 2026-10-06T12:00:00Z] AND id NOT IN exclusions -> cna.cwe usable AND cna.cpe well-formed AND cpe.vendor IN cpe_vendor_aliases('summit-analytics')
